name: ultracode-prefix-only-for-built-in-claude-at-max-effort
description: On the built-in Claude harness at Ultra effort ("max"), every outgoing prompt is sent with the "ultracode" keyword and a blank line in front of it. The transcript keeps the person's own words.
reason: The claude CLI has no flag for dynamic multi-agent workflows; the documented opt-in is the "ultracode" prompt keyword. Ultra effort means the person wants those workflows, so PowerUp adds the keyword on the wire without putting words in their mouth on screen.

script.reason: The first prompt launches the session and is sent with the keyword.
Every prompt is prefixed, not only the first.
